answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 147072 Country: India Title: It is seen that many people offer Quran to masjids for isal-e-sawab. But such volumes are kept unread for many days. Whether such volumes can be diverted to madrasas? Question: It is seen that many people offer Quran to masjids for isal-e-sawab. But such volumes are kept unread for many days. Whether such volumes can be diverted to madrasas? Answer ID: 147072 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 315/284/B=3/1438) Yes, the copies of such extra Quran may be given in the madrasa after the advice of elders from your areas, so that they could be used for reading and the donor could get the reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
